records.question: How long does Spotify hold on to my personal information?
records.text: Spotify holds your personal information for as long as necessary to provide the Spotify Service and for legitimate business purposes. For example, personal data you input as part of search queries is deleted after 90 days. Some data, like your Spotify username and profile information, is retained until your account is deleted. Streaming history is kept for the life of the account to provide personalized recommendations [Spotify – 6. Data retention].

records.question: Will Spotify give my money back if I cancel partway through a subscription period?
records.text: Spotify does not provide refunds or credits for any partial subscription periods, except as expressly stated in these Terms [Spotify – Billing and cancellation].

records.question: Can I team up with other Spotify customers to sue the company as a group?
records.text: No, you cannot team up with other Spotify customers to sue the company as a group. The Terms of Service state that neither party may participate as a plaintiff, claimant, or class member in any class, collective, consolidated, private attorney general, or representative proceeding [Spotify – Governing law, jurisdiction, class action waiver, and jury trial waiver].
cited_labels: [Spotify – Governing law, jurisdiction, class action waiver, and jury trial waiver]

records.question: How old do you need to be to open a Netflix account?
records.text: You need to be at least 18 years of age to open a Netflix account [Netflix – 1. The Netflix Service].

records.question: Can somebody who doesn't live with me use my Netflix plan?
records.text: Yes, someone who doesn't live with you can use your Netflix plan if you have an Extra Member account, which is available in certain countries [Netflix – 1. The Netflix Service].

records.question: How long does Netflix hang on to my details?
records.text: Netflix retains your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described, such as providing their service, administering their business, and complying with legal obligations. The exact duration depends on factors like your relationship with Netflix, the nature of the information, and legal requirements [Netflix – Retention of Personal Information].

records.question: How long does Lyft store records of my past trips and payments?
records.text: Lyft stores records of your past trips and payments for at least seven years to ensure they can perform legitimate business functions, such as accounting for tax obligations [Lyft – How We Store and Protect Your Information].
cited_labels: [Lyft – How We Store and Protect Your Information]

records.question: Will Lyft charge me if I book a ride and never turn up?
records.text: Yes, Lyft may charge you if you book a ride and never turn up. This is referred to as a cancellation fee, which may apply if you fail to show up after requesting a ride [Lyft – Charges].

records.question: Can a 17 year old ride with Lyft?
records.text: Yes, a 17-year-old can ride with Lyft if they are using Rideshare Services, provided they are accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who has created a User account for them and meets the specified requirements [Lyft – Eligibility].

records.question: Is Lyft making money by selling my data?
records.text: Lyft does not sell your personal information to third parties for money [Lyft – How We Disclose Your Information]. However, they may share your personal information with third parties to deliver relevant personalized ads, which could involve "sharing" or the "sale" of personal information under certain privacy laws [Lyft – How We Disclose Your Information]. Therefore, Lyft is not making money by selling your data directly, but they may use your data for targeted advertising purposes.

records.question: What's the youngest age allowed on Discord?
records.text: The youngest age allowed on Discord is 13 years old [Discord – Age requirements and responsibility of parents and legal guardians].
cited_labels: [Discord – Age requirements and responsibility of parents and legal guardians]

records.question: Does Discord sell what it knows about me to advertisers?
records.text: Discord may share information with advertising platforms to help reach people who might like their products and to measure the performance of their ads. This is done to bring more users to Discord and make their business successful [Discord – How we disclose your information]. However, they do not make money from selling your personal information to third parties [Discord – A little bit about Discord].

records.question: What happens if a lot of people bring the same dispute against Discord at once?
records.text: If a lot of people bring the same dispute against Discord at once, the dispute may be resolved through arbitration, and the arbitration process may limit the ability to pursue claims as a class or representative action. Specifically, the Class Action Waiver and Class Arbitration and Collective Relief Waiver provisions state that disputes must be pursued on an individual basis, and the arbitrator may award relief only in favor of the individual party seeking relief [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord].
cited_labels: [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord]

records.question: Are kids allowed to have a Reddit account?
records.text: Kids under the age of 13 are not allowed to create an account or otherwise use the Services [Reddit – Children].

records.question: What rights does Reddit get over the things I post?
records.text: Reddit gains the right to use your content worldwide, and you irrevocably waive any claims and assertions of moral rights or attribution with respect to your content [Reddit – 5. Your Content]. You also agree that Reddit may remove metadata associated with your content [Reddit – 5. Your Content].

records.question: How long does Reddit hold on to my IP address?
records.text: Reddit holds your IP address for up to 100 days after collection. After that period, Reddit will delete any IP addresses collected [Reddit – What Information We Collect].

records.question: Will my paid Zoom plan keep billing me automatically?
records.text: Yes, your paid Zoom plan may keep billing you automatically, as per the terms related to recurring subscription Charges and automatic renewals [Zoom – Effective Date: August 11, 2023].

records.question: Can other people read my Zoom Email messages?
records.text: Yes, other people can read your Zoom Email messages if they have access to the email content or if the emails are not end-to-end encrypted. Account owners and designated account administrators can access email and calendar content sent to and from users on their Zoom Email or Zoom Calendar accounts, even if those Zoom Emails are encrypted [Zoom – Who Can See, Share, and Process My Personal Data When I Join Meetings and Use Other Zoom Products and Services?]. Additionally, recipients of Zoom Emails and Zoom Calendar invites can see, save, and share your email and calendar content with others [Zoom – Who Can See, Share, and Process My Personal Data When I Join Meetings and Use Other Zoom Products and Services?]. Emails sent to or received from non-Zoom Email users are encrypted after the email is sent or received from Zoom’s servers, if the Zoom Email user chooses to send them with encryption. However, Zoom has access to email metadata used for basic email delivery, including email addresses in the from, to, cc, and bcc fields [Zoom – What Personal Data Do We Receive?].
cited_labels: [Zoom – What Personal Data Do We Receive?]
[Zoom – Who Can See, Share, and Process My Personal Data When I Join Meetings and Use Other Zoom Products and Services?]

records.question: Is Zoom allowed to shut down a service I'm paying for?
records.text: Yes, Zoom may shut down a service you're paying for if you fail to comply with any provision of this Agreement or any referenced policies, guides, notices, or statements, or if there is a failure to pay Charges for five (5) calendar days following the due date [Zoom – 14. TERM; TERMINATION AND SUSPENSION]. Additionally, Zoom may terminate this Agreement for any reason or no reason, upon thirty (30) business days’ advance notice [Zoom – 14. TERM; TERMINATION AND SUSPENSION].

records.question: Do I give up my right to a jury if I have a dispute with Coursera?
records.text: Yes, you give up your right to a jury if you have a dispute with Coursera. The Terms of Service include an arbitration agreement that waives your right to a jury trial [Coursera – Thank you for using Coursera!].

records.question: Could Coursera still have my data after I ask them to erase it?
records.text: Yes, Coursera may still have some of your data after you ask them to erase it. They may retain limited Personal Data where necessary for lawful and legitimate purposes, which may vary depending on your location, such as complying with legal obligations. Additionally, residual information may remain within their databases, access logs, or other records, which may or may not contain your Personal Data [Coursera – Your Rights].

records.question: Can a teenager sign up for their own PayPal account?
records.text: No, a teenager cannot sign up for their own PayPal account. To open a PayPal account, an individual must be at least 18 years old [Paypal – Welcome to PayPal!].

records.question: How long does PayPal keep my information once I stop being a customer?
records.text: PayPal retains your Personal Information for the duration of your relationship plus a period of 10 years or such period as mandated by any applicable local law once our relationship comes to an end, unless we need to keep it longer to the extent permitted by applicable law, such as for legal obligations, litigation, investigations, audit and compliance practices, or to protect against legal claims [Paypal – How Long We Store Your Personal Information].

records.question: How much time do I have to get my money back from my bank for a PayPal SEPA debit?

records.text: To join Strava, you need to be at least 13 years old. If you are under the legal age to form a binding contract in your jurisdiction, your parent or legal guardian must review and agree to these Terms on your behalf [Strava – Registration and Accounts].

records.question: If I close my Strava account, does my data actually go away?
records.text: If you close your Strava account, your data is permanently and irreversibly deleted from Strava's systems, including backups. However, it may take up to 45 days to fully delete your personal information and system logs from their systems [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data]. Additionally, Strava may retain some information to comply with the law, prevent fraud, collect fees, resolve disputes, troubleshoot problems, assist with investigations, enforce the Terms of Service, and take other actions permitted by law [Strava – Retention of Information].

records.question: What can Pinterest do with the pictures I upload?
records.text: Pinterest can use the pictures you upload to show you content and ads on and off Pinterest that are relevant to you [Pinterest – 1. The Service]. You retain all rights in, and are solely responsible for, the User Content you post to Pinterest [Pinterest – a. Posting User Content].

records.question: Does Pinterest use the websites I visit to show me ads?
records.text: Yes, Pinterest uses the websites you visit to show you ads. They disclose information such as cookie IDs, your IP address, and a hashed version of your email address to services they use to market Pinterest to you on sites and apps other than Pinterest [Pinterest – To deliver ads, off Pinterest, that are relevant, interesting and personal to you about Pinterest, we:]. Additionally, they use your information to personalize the ads you see, including your onsite and offsite activities, to show you relevant ads both on and off Pinterest [Pinterest – We also use your information to personalize the ads you see].
